description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Details' feature for user information retrieval, including request validation, handling, and mapping to output envelops in an ASP.NET Core application.

classes.name: Details.Query
classes.description: Represents the request to get user details based on username.

classes.name: Details.QueryValidator
classes.description: Validates the Query to ensure the username is not null or empty.

classes.name: Details.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the user details request by querying the database, mapping data, and generating a token.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the Query to retrieve user info, handles not found case, maps entity to DTO, and generates JWT token.
